meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 改说极简「穴居人」话:删除客套废话,保留技术要点与代码。支持 lite/full/ultra/文言文等档位,可用「stop caveman」关闭。
howto.when: 当你说「caveman mode」「be brief」「less tokens」等,或输入 /caveman,或要求省 token 时触发。

say.note: 开启默认的 full 档穴居人回复。

say.text: 用 ultra 档压缩回复
say.note: 把档位调到 ultra,回复更短。
关闭穴居人模式,恢复正常说话。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude's replies into ultra-terse 'caveman' style: remove filler/pleasantries, keep technical accuracy and code. Adjustable levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan-lite/full/ultra. Off with 'stop caveman'.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'caveman mode', 'be brief', 'less tokens' (or similar), type /caveman, or ask for token efficiency.

say_en.note: Turns on ultra level, even terser.
